description: Adding the resolvent of two member clauses preserves exactly the satisfying valuations of a finite clause set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.add_resolvent_models.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  {Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α} {C D : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Clause α} {p : α}
  (hC : C ∈ Γ) (hD : D ∈ Γ) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models v (insert (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.resolvent p C D) Γ) ↔
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models v Γ
